# Fresh tactical validation starts

Eight authored starts on four boards, with both movers, test broader capture and
escape branching than the constrained training curriculum. Each includes a legal
terminal witness for mechanical fixture verification. The learner never consumes
witness labels. These are synthetic positions, not opening-reachable trajectories,
forced-outcome classifications or independent referee rulings.

Tests exclude every rotation/reflection of all current training boards and the
previously viewed `copenhagen-heldout-v1` diagnostic corpus. These boards were
constructed and mechanically checked before the next model comparison, not chosen
from model performance. Training seeds, opponent schedules, budgets, dataset hashes
and checkpoint-selection rules must be frozen before evaluating them.

This is a public validation set within the same broad tactical families as the
training data. Board-level separation is not proof of family-level independence.
After viewing results it is no longer unseen evidence for later choices. Do not
optimize against it or call it a hidden/final strength benchmark. Keep the earlier
public diagnostic separate and freeze independent opening-start evaluation before
making a competitive-strength claim.
